events.what: Aleman and Kouroupis prove Brennan's conjecture for domains that are images of continuous semigroups of holomorphic self-maps of the disk
Jin determines the integral means spectrum of univalent rational functions on the disk, giving Brennan's conjecture for that class
events.credibility_reason: 13 revisions within about six months suggests the argument has been patched repeatedly; no identified error, and the author works in the area.

events.what: Zheng proves Brennan's conjecture for basins of attraction at infinity of certain monic polynomials

judgement.doubts: All three events are restrictions to classes of simply connected domains, so each is a case; the Zheng basins are still simply connected domains mapped conformally, so the record's 'variant' worry does not apply. None is a full proof. Status, AI role and direction all agree with the record. Jin's many revisions are a mild doubt only.
